topic: BepiColombo spacecraft enters Mercury orbit after eight-year journey
title: BepiColombo Spacecraft Enters Mercury Orbit After Eight-Year Journey
dek: The ESA-JAXA mission reached Mercury on November 21, 2026, after traveling about 10 billion km and becoming only the second spacecraft to orbit the planet.
body:
The BepiColombo spacecraft entered orbit around Mercury on November 21, 2026. This marks the second time a mission has achieved this feat after NASA's MESSENGER. The joint ESA and JAXA probe covered roughly 10 billion km during its eight-year trip from Earth.

A power glitch in 2024 pushed the arrival back by one year from the original 2025 target. Despite that setback, the spacecraft completed its orbital insertion. A software issue shortened the final burn, yet capture into orbit succeeded without further problems.

The mission carries two separate orbiters that remain joined for now. The ESA-built Mercury Planetary Orbiter and the JAXA-built Mio orbiter will stay together until Mio separates on December 9-10, 2026. The MPO will then adjust to its final science orbit by March 2027.

## Science Operations

Full science operations are set to begin in April 2027. The two spacecraft will study Mercury's magnetic field, surface composition, and internal core structure at the same time. This dual-orbiter approach provides the first simultaneous measurements from different vantage points around the innermost planet.

The primary mission is planned to last one year, with the possibility of an extension if the spacecraft remain healthy. Data collected during this period should offer clearer details on how Mercury formed and evolved compared with earlier single-spacecraft observations.
